title: 第159章 真正的巫师塔第158章 你小子      你是早有预谋
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: “真正的巫师塔？”
“桀桀桀，战争要塞上那座算什么巫师塔。”噬能虫从他头顶飞起来，“那只是主人临时落脚的地方。碧影森林学院里这座，才是主人花了三千年一点点建起来的。”
它朝前方飞去，声音从前面飘回来。
“跟上来，别磨蹭。”
伊森抬脚跟上去。
脚下的石板路从灰白色变成了深青色，路两侧的树木越来越高，树干粗得需要十几个人合抱。
树冠在高处层层叠叠地铺展开，将大部分阳光挡在外面。几道光柱从叶缝间漏下来，在地面上投出斑驳的光斑。
走了约莫两个半小时，前方的树木骤然稀疏。
伊森停下脚步。
视线尽头，一座高塔矗立在森林中央。
塔身不是从地面开始的。
整座塔悬浮在一片碧绿色的湖水上空，距离湖面大概十米。
塔基呈倒锥形，由无数粗壮的树根编织而成，那些树根从湖水中伸出来，缠绕、交织、盘旋，在塔基下方形成一个巨大的根须平台。
根须表面流转着翠绿色的符文纹路，每一次明灭都会在湖面上激起一圈圈涟漪。
塔身由深青色的木质材料构筑，和战争要塞上那座巫师塔的材质看着相似，但细节完全不同。
塔身表面没有符文纹路，取而代之的是无数细密的藤蔓。
那些藤蔓从塔基一直爬到塔尖，每一根都有拇指粗细，藤蔓上长满了指甲盖大小的翠绿色叶片。
叶片在微风中轻轻颤动，发出沙沙的声响。
塔身呈螺旋状向上延伸，每上升一段距离就会向外延伸出一圈平台。
平台上种满了各种植物，有些开着拳头大小的花朵，有些挂着沉甸甸的果实，还有些垂下长长的藤条，藤条末端垂进湖水里。
塔尖高耸入云，顶端悬浮着一枚拳头大小的翠绿色光球。
光球缓慢旋转，每转一圈就会向四周扩散一圈极淡的光晕。
光晕扫过湖面时，湖水会泛起细密的波纹。
湖岸边生长着成片的发光蘑菇，每一朵都有脸盆大小。
蘑菇伞盖呈半透明的淡青色，内部流转着细密的光点。
光点从伞盖中飘出来，在空气中缓慢上升，汇入塔尖那枚光球中。
几条由藤蔓编织的小桥从湖岸延伸到塔基下方，桥面铺着暗青色的木板，桥栏上缠绕着发光的藤蔓。
湖水清澈见底，能看见湖底铺满了拳头大小的翠绿色晶石，晶石内部流转的光芒将整片湖水映成一片碧绿。
几只半透明的水母状生物在湖水中缓慢游动。
它们的身体呈淡青色，伞盖边缘垂下无数细长的触须，触须末端散发着淡金色的微光。
它们绕着塔基游动，触须在水中划出一道道光痕。
伊森站在湖岸边，仰头看着那座塔。
战争要塞上的巫师塔已经够震撼了，但和眼前这座比起来，大概只配当个门房。
噬能虫从他头顶探出半个身子，“桀桀桀，看傻了吧？主人的巫师塔可是整个巫师世界所有四环学院里排得上号的。光是塔基下那片聚能湖，每年产出的魔晶就够买下三百个二环学院。那些湖底的晶石看见没？全是主人用本源之力培育的，随便捞一颗出来都值几十魔晶。”
它从他头顶飞起来，悬在半空中，六条腿在空中划拉了几下。
“还有塔身上那些藤蔓，叫碧落藤，每一根藤蔓都有自己的意识，能自动识别敌我。上次有个不开眼的二级巫师想偷偷溜进去，被藤蔓捆成粽子挂在外头晾了三天三夜。”
content_en:
"A real wizard's tower?"
"Jie Jie Jie, that wizard tower on the war fortress is nothing." Energy-eating insects flew from above his head. "That is just a temporary place for the master to stay. The one in Biying Forest Academy was built by the master little by little for three thousand years."
It flew forward, and the sound floated back from the front.
"Follow me, don't waste time."
Ethan lifted his feet and followed.
The stone road beneath my feet changed from gray-white to dark blue. The trees on both sides of the road were getting taller and taller, and their trunks were so thick that more than a dozen people needed to hug them.
The canopy spreads out in layers high up, blocking out most of the sunlight. Several beams of light leaked from between the leaves, casting mottled light spots on the ground.
After walking for about two and a half hours, the trees in front suddenly became sparse.
Ethan stopped.
At the end of the line of sight, a tall tower stood in the middle of the forest.
The tower does not start from the ground.
The entire tower is suspended above a turquoise lake, about ten meters away from the lake.
The base of the tower is in the shape of an inverse cone, woven by countless thick tree roots. Those tree roots protrude from the lake water, entwine, intertwine, and spiral, forming a huge root platform under the base of the tower.
There are emerald green rune patterns flowing on the surface of the roots, and every time they light up or disappear, they will cause circles of ripples on the lake.
The tower body is made of dark blue wooden material. The material looks similar to the wizard tower on the war fortress, but the details are completely different.
There are no rune patterns on the surface of the tower, instead there are countless fine vines.
Those vines climbed from the base of the tower to the top of the tower. Each one was as thick as a thumb. The vines were covered with emerald green leaves the size of fingernails.
The leaves trembled gently in the breeze, making a rustling sound.
The tower body extends upward in a spiral shape, and a circle of platforms extends outward every time it rises a certain distance.
The platform is covered with various plants, some with fist-sized flowers, some with heavy fruits, and some with long vines hanging down, the ends of which hang into the lake.
The tower towers high into the clouds, with an emerald-green ball of light the size of a fist suspended at the top.
The ball of light rotates slowly, and with each revolution, a very faint halo of light spreads around.
When the halo sweeps across the lake, the water will create fine ripples.
There are patches of glowing mushrooms growing on the shore of the lake, each one the size of a washbasin.
The mushroom cap is translucent light cyan, with fine spots of light flowing inside.
The light spots floated out from the umbrella cover, slowly rose in the air, and merged into the light ball at the top of the tower.
Several small bridges woven with vines extend from the lake shore to the base of the tower. The bridge deck is paved with dark blue wooden boards, and the bridge rails are wrapped with glowing vines.
The lake is crystal clear, and you can see that the bottom of the lake is covered with fist-sized emerald green crystals. The light flowing inside the crystals reflects the entire lake into a green color.
Several translucent jellyfish-like creatures swam slowly in the lake.
Their bodies are light cyan, with countless slender tentacles hanging from the edge of the umbrella canopy, and the ends of the tentacles exude a light golden shimmer.
They swam around the base of the tower, their tentacles creating streaks of light in the water.
Ethan stood on the shore of the lake, looking up at the tower.
The wizard tower on the war fortress is shocking enough, but compared with the one in front of you, it is probably only worthy of being a concierge.
The energy-devouring worm leaned out half of his body from above his head, "Jiejiejie, are you stupid? The master's wizard tower ranks among the top four-ring academies in the entire wizarding world. The energy-gathering lake under the tower base alone produces enough magic crystals to buy three hundred second-ring academies every year. Do you see those crystals at the bottom of the lake? They are all cultivated by the master with the original power. Any one taken out is worth dozens of magic crystals."
It flew up from above his head and hung in the air, its six legs swiping in the air several times.
"There are also those vines on the tower, called Biluo vines. Each vine has its own consciousness and can automatically identify ourselves and the enemy. Last time, a blind second-level wizard wanted to sneak in, and was tied into a rice dumpling by the vines and hung outside to dry for three days and nights."
